title: Crucible Project Configuration
description: Schema for .crucible/config.yaml — the project-local configuration file that tells Crucible how to run against a specific project.

crucible_root.description: Path to this project's installed Crucible bundle. Must point inside the application repo, typically .crucible. The orchestrator invokes `<crucible_root>/powershell/factory.ps1` from the project directory.

project.description: Identity and basic metadata for the target project.

name.description: Short display name for the project.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the project does.

default_branch.description: The branch Operator merges to. Usually 'main' or 'master'.

paths.description: Filesystem paths for Crucible runtime directories, all relative to the project root and rooted under .crucible/.

backlog.description: Backlog directory (BACKLOG.md, features/, bugs/, chores/, blocked/).

session.description: Session directory (handoffs/, scratchpads, event logs, global state).

workspaces.description: Root for Architect git worktrees (one per in-flight task).

prompts.description: Installed prompt template directory for this project.

personas.description: Installed persona definitions directory for this project.

sops.description: Installed standard operating procedures directory for this project.

roles.description: Model tier assignment per specialist role. Controls which AI model class is used for each specialist.

verification.description: Shell commands the Reviewer runs to verify Architect work. Must be tailored to the project's language and toolchain.

quick.description: Fast check — run after every Architect commit. Typically just the test suite.

full.description: Complete check — run by the Reviewer before approval. Mirrors CI exactly: vet, lint, tests, doc-lint.

project_mandates.description: Project-specific engineering rules that every specialist must respect. The Reviewer checks these during scope validation. Examples: 'No CGO', 'All public functions must have JSDoc'.

file_affinity_examples.description: Optional. Illustrative examples of package paths or globs used in file_affinity declarations. Not enforced — just documentation for the Groomer.

model_tier.description: Model capability class for this role.

name.description: Display name shown in factory output and Reviewer reports.

command.description: Shell command to execute. Must not contain scaffold placeholder values.
